parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not configure this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the policy. Valid values:

*   **0**: disabled
*   **1**: pending enabling
*   **2**: enabled
*   **3**: expired

parameters.name: Template
parameters.description:
The type of the template that is used to create the policy. Valid values:

*   **promotion**: the Important Activity template
*   **bypass**: the Forward All template

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-scene-defense-policies --template promotion --status 1 --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
